system.description: A circlet of black thorn the Wardens of the Flow cut from the last orchard in the Heartlands to bear fruit. Once per day, as ◈◈, a 10' burst within 30' erupts in thorns until the encounter ends: it is difficult terrain, and any creature that ends its turn inside takes d4 damage. Allies are not spared. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: ◈◈ Plant it within 60': a 30' burst becomes a thicket for 1 hour. It is difficult terrain, and every creature inside when it grows is Restrained until the end of its next turn. Allies are not spared.
system.drawback: Nele's thorns grow inward: you take d4 persistent bleeding damage at the start of every combat until it is recovered.
